narrative.text:
THE KRAVENSTAL WORKER
VOICE OF VELTRIA'S WORKING PEOPLE
1 JANUARY 1963

SHE CAME FROM US
Kravenstal's daughter takes the highest office

Her father worked the foundries. Her mother took in mending to keep the lights on. Today their daughter stood at the podium in Republic Square and took the oath that Halvek took — but she took it differently. You could feel it even through the radio.

Workers in the Kravenstal industrial district gathered around radio sets in break rooms, canteens, and union halls to hear the ceremony. When it was over, nobody went back to work immediately. They just sat with it for a while.

Our demands remain the same as they were yesterday: restore the pension freeze adjustments. Reinstate the collective bargaining rights stripped in 1957. Invest in the northern infrastructure that has been neglected for a decade. We are not asking for favors. We are asking for what was taken.
We wish Chancellor Ashavel well. We will be watching.
